fact: The General Authority for Communications and Informatics states in its August 2025 ITU GSR-25 submission that the share of government services provided digitally has risen to over 45% and more than 20 government institutions are integrated into a unified digital services platform; it does not name the national strategy or measure against its targets.
title: Libya's Participation in GSR-25: Libya's Experience in Digital Transformation: From Challenges to Empowerment
publisher: General Authority for Communications and Informatics, Libya (submitted to ITU)
